create_dataset_make_classification: create a synthetic classification dataset with configurable samples, features, and informative columns
build_model_LinearSVC: build a linear support vector classifier with L1 or L2 penalty and squared hinge loss
test_cv_ShardleSplit: test model performance using ShuffleSplit cross-validation with configurable train size and splits
run_validation_curve: run validation curve to compute training and test scores across a range of regularization parameter C values
plot_results_matplotlib: plot cross-validation scores against regularization parameter C with log-scale x-axis and scaling comparison
